title: Quiz question file
description: A file in questions/ is a JSON list of multiple-choice questions. Checked by `npm run check` (lib/questions.js mirrors these rules).

id.description: Unique and stable, e.g. 'l03-q07'. Never reuse or rename an id; give a changed question a new id.

explanation.description: Why the answer is right and why the most tempting wrong option is wrong.

topic.description: Exactly one of the lecture names in course.json.

code.description: Code, a query or a table shown in a monospace block (\n for new lines).

shuffle.description: false keeps the options in order.

hints.description: Revealed one at a time before answering; must not give the answer away.
